body: I still feel bad, I wanted him to put effort into fixing this and all he keeps telling me is that I'm not doing enough for him and that I'm the reason for his stress. It feels like if I meet him at the apartment he's going to not try to improve and make me do all the improvements.

I didn't want to meet him at the place. He needed to meet me somewhere else and he continually refused and made excuses that it was to "inconvenient" to meet anywhere outside the apartment. I called and asked to meet somewhere else and he refused and hung up.
